name: elagoht/honeypot
description: A collage plugin that stops form spam without a CAPTCHA: a decoy field people never see, and a signed timestamp that says how long the form was open.

templateFunctions.name: honeypot
templateFunctions.doc: The invisible decoy field and signed timestamp that stop form spam bots. Put it inside every protected form.

collage-honeypot.description: collage-honeypot: the decoy field that stops spam bots, inside a form

config.description: A collage plugin that stops form spam without a CAPTCHA: a decoy field people never see, and a signed timestamp that says how long the form was open.

field.description: Field is the decoy's name: something a bot is keen to fill in. Default "website".

key.description: KeyHex is Key, hex-encoded, as configuration carries it.

maxAge.description: MaxAge is how many seconds a served form stays good for. Default 86400, one day.

maxBody.description: MaxBody is the largest body, in bytes, the plugin reads to check it; a larger form body is refused with 413. Default 4 MiB, collage's own default limit on an action's body. Raise it with an action's WithMaxBodyBytes for a form that uploads large files.

minDelay.description: MinDelay is how many seconds a form must be open before it is sent; a person takes longer than that to read and fill one in. Default 2; -1 turns the check off.

protect.description: Protect are the path prefixes whose submissions are checked. Default ["/"], every form the site accepts — each of which must then carry {{honeypot}}.

silent.description: Silent answers a refused submission with 303 See Other to the page it came from, as an accepted form is answered, so a bot believes it succeeded and does not try another way. Default false: 400 Bad Request.

skip.description: Skip are path prefixes never checked, even under Protect. Default ["/_collage/"].
